metadata.clip_area: Bounding box of the building inventory; shadows of buildings outside it are missing near the edges
metadata.method: Flat-roofed prisms at height_m swept along the sun direction onto flat ground (data/sources/shadows.py)
limitations: Ground is treated as flat; real slopes lengthen or shorten shadows.
Each building is one flat-roofed prism at its average roof height; towers on podiums are approximated.
Shadows falling on walls and roofs are not shown; only open ground is shaded.
Proposal masses are simplified boxes, so their shadows are indicative, not a design study.
Trees, canopies and signs are not modelled.
